changes: GET /api/v2/org/agent-permissions — removed the required property `results/pilotPreset` from the response with the `200` status
POST /api/v2/org/agent-permissions/pilot-preset — api path removed without deprecation

declaredAdvisories.reason: Agent identity (beta, agent-identity feature flag) removes POST /api/v2/org/agent-permissions/pilot-preset and the pilotPreset field from GET /api/v2/org/agent-permissions. The agent-identity flag is off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted, and the endpoint refuses callers when the flag is off. No released Lightdash UI ever called the endpoint or read the field. API clients get a 404 and must save the capability ceiling with PUT /api/v2/org/agent-permissions instead.
